rules.instruction: When the description says that one participant sends an item to another participant and describes the recipient acting on it: Model the participants’ work in their respective processes and connect the communication with a message flow between their pools; keep sequence flows within each participant’s process.
rules.situation: the description says that one participant sends an item to another participant and describes the recipient acting on it

rules.instruction: When the description states that a decision can lead to two or more mutually exclusive actions: Model each alternative on its own exclusive branch, and represent each stated action with its own activity; use a terminal outcome instead when the description states only an outcome.
rules.situation: the description states that a decision can lead to two or more mutually exclusive actions

rules.instruction: When the description states that a participant performs an initiating action before another participant begins the process work.: Model the initiating action as an activity after a start event, rather than absorbing it into the start event.
rules.situation: the description states that one participant performs an initiating action before another participant begins its work
